CRAS: iodev_list - Skip ramping if device volume is zero When adjusted active node volume is zero, or system volume is zero, samples of a device will be suppressed to zero. chromeos-accelerometer-init: Set calibration to default when VPD is invalid If invalid calibration data has been sent to the EC, it may stick until EC is restarted. In case of invalid VPD data we must set the calibias to 0. We leave calibscale untouched given it is only used for older systems and has been set to a constant value (1024). Also, using /var/lib revealed a hidden dependency of accelerometer-init, chromeos-startup. We need to be sure chromeos-startup has mounted /mnt/stateful for accelerometer-init to run properly. BUG=chrome-os-partner:62342 CQ-DEPEND=CL:448158 TEST=Unit tests On veyron and cave, check by setting vpd_data_valid to "valid" and "invalid" that the calibbias is changed while the calibscale is unchanged. Testing on cave, there is a slight decrease in boot time (+25ms to login): cros-ec-accel initialization is not done while splash screen is being displayed, but did not add a reverse dependency. UPSTREAM: net: ipv4: Don't crash if passing a null sk to ip_do_redirect. Commit e2d118a1cb5e ("net: inet: Support UID-based routing in IP protocols.") made ip_do_redirect call sock_net(sk) to determine the network namespace of the passed-in socket. This crashes if sk is NULL. Fix this by getting the network namespace from the skb instead. Fixes: e2d118a1cb5e ("net: inet: Support UID-based routing in IP protocols.")
